segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let radius = kernelLength / 2 let diameter = (radius * 2) + 1 let kernels: [vImage.ConvolutionKernel2D<Int16>] = (1 ... 4).map { index in let weights = [Int16](unsafeUninitializedCapacity: diameter * diameter) { buffer, initializedCount in for x in 0 ..< diameter { for y in 0 ..< diameter { if hypot(Float(radius - x), Float(radius - y)) < Float(radius / index) { buffer[y * diameter + x] = 1 } else { buffer[y * diameter + x] = 0 } } } initializedCount = diameter * diameter } return vImage.ConvolutionKernel2D(values: weights, size: .init(width: kernelLength, height: kernelLength)) } ```
